job.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager - Shape the future of fan engagement!
job.description:
Shape the customer journeys behind some of Australia's biggest live events!

We're partnering with a global leader in digital entertainment to recruit a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager who will lead customer lifecycle strategy across Australia and New Zealand.

This is an outstanding opportunity to join a business at the forefront of live entertainment, where you'll develop and deliver sophisticated, data-driven marketing campaigns that drive ticket sales, grow audiences and create exceptional fan experiences.

Working closely with both local and global teams, you'll own the strategy and execution of customer lifecycle initiatives, from acquisition and engagement through to retention and loyalty, while partnering with some of the country's leading venues, promoters and entertainment brands.

About the Role:

As the senior marketing lead across customer lifecycle and CRM, you'll be responsible for developing integrated marketing strategies that deliver measurable commercial outcomes while enhancing every stage of the customer journey.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, working across multiple campaigns simultaneously while collaborating with internal stakeholders, external clients and agency partners to deliver best-in-class marketing programs.

This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to influence marketing strategy, optimise customer engagement and help shape the future of one of Australia's most exciting entertainment businesses.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Developing lifecycle marketing strategies that drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention and repeat attendance.
  • Leading integrated marketing campaigns across CRM, email, paid media, social, web, affiliate marketing and other digital channels.
  • Owning campaign planning, execution, optimisation and post-campaign analysis.
  • Building audience segmentation strategies that deliver personalised customer experiences.
  • Using customer insights and performance data to continually improve campaign effectiveness and commercial outcomes.
  • Managing campaign budgets and optimising marketing investment across channels.
  • Acting as a trusted marketing partner to key clients, venues and promoters, providing strategic recommendations and campaign leadership.
  • Working closely with global marketing, data and technology teams to deliver scalable lifecycle initiatives.
  • Leading campaign reporting and presenting insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Mentoring and supporting members of the marketing team while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.
About You:

You'll be an experienced CRM or lifecycle marketer who thrives in a fast-paced, commercially driven environment and enjoys balancing strategy with execution.
We're looking for someone who brings:
  • Proven experience leading customer lifecycle, CRM or integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Strong experience developing customer journeys, segmentation strategies and data-led marketing programs.
  • Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels including email, paid media, social and web.
  • A commercial mindset with the ability to translate marketing activity into measurable business outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience partnering with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical capability and confidence interpreting campaign performance and customer insights.
  • Outstanding project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
You'll Stand Out If You Have:
  • Experience within ticketing, live entertainment, sport, hospitality or other high-volume B2C environments.
  • Experience working with customer data, audience segmentation and marketing automation platforms.
  • A passion for creating exceptional customer experiences through data-driven marketing.
  • Existing relationships across the entertainment, venue or events industry.
Why Join?

This is a rare opportunity to join a globally recognised organisation at an exciting stage of growth across the ANZ region.

You'll work on high-profile campaigns that connect millions of fans with unforgettable live experiences, collaborate with talented teams across Australia and internationally, and have the opportunity to influence the future of customer engagement within a business renowned for innovation and technology.

If you're an experienced lifecycle marketer looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you!
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Marketing Executive - B2B / A National Leading Residential Builder
job.description:
An exciting opportunity has become available for an ambitious Marketing Executive to join the marketing team of one of Australia’s leading residential building groups.

This newly created role offers fantastic breadth for an early-career marketer looking to build their experience across digital marketing, content, campaigns, lead generation, events and brand within a large and established Australian business.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager and broader sales and marketing teams, you’ll support marketing activity across the group’s residential building and manufacturing divisions, giving you exposure to both B2C and largely B2B audiences.

This is a hands-on role where no two days will look the same. You’ll be encouraged to bring ideas to the table, be curious, think creatively and take ownership of your projects.

What you'll be doing:
  • Support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns designed to drive brand awareness, lead generation and sales
  • Develop engaging content across websites, social media, EDMs, blogs and marketing collateral
  • Support B2B marketing activity targeting distributors, dealers, trade partners and industrial customers
  • Assist with paid search, display and broader digital campaigns
  • Manage and update website content, product information and promotional pages
  • Develop and manage EDM calendars to nurture prospective customers and support lead conversion
  • Create content for LinkedIn and other B2B channels to strengthen brand presence and industry authority
  • Work closely with sales teams to ensure marketing activity supports commercial and lead-generation objectives
  • Monitor campaign performance and assist with reporting across digital activity, leads, sales and conversion
  • Coordinate marketing collateral, merchandise, brochures and promotional materials
  • Support new product launches and internal marketing communications
  • Assist with trade shows, industry exhibitions, supplier events and new location/display launches
  • Monitor competitor activity and identify new opportunities to increase awareness and engagement
  • Contribute ideas to marketing brainstorms and help bring new campaign concepts to life
About you:

You'll ideally be an energetic and commercially minded marketer with around 12–18 months' marketing experience who is ready to take the next step in your career.

You'll bring:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Marketing or a related discipline
  • Approximately 12–18 months' experience within a marketing role
  • Exposure to B2B, property, construction, manufacturing or industrial marketing would be highly regarded
  • Strong digital marketing knowledge and an interest in campaign performance and lead generation
  • Experience working with CRM systems
  • Strong written communication and copywriting skills
  • The ability to juggle multiple projects, priorities and deadlines
  • A proactive, organised and collaborative approach
  • Plenty of energy, curiosity and a genuine can-do attitude
  • A current driver's licence
Why consider this opportunity?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a large, established Australian residential building group at an exciting stage of its evolution.

Rather than being pigeonholed into one area of marketing, you'll gain exposure across digital, content, campaigns, CRM, events, brand, B2B and B2C marketing, working closely with experienced senior marketers and commercial teams.

It's an ideal next move for someone early in their marketing career who wants breadth, ownership and the opportunity to develop quickly within a well-established business.

Location: Melbourne / Ballarat. The successful candidate will need to be able to work from Ballarat approximately 1–2 days per fortnight, so a driver's licence and willingness to travel are essential.

You'll work within an exceptional marketing team, that are currently kicking some serious goals, are super engaging, have passion and energy and a real spark! 

To submit an application for this role, please APPLY NOW.
